title: Hazael threatens Jerusalem
summary: Hazael of Aram goes up against Jerusalem and Joash buys him off with the temple treasures (2 Kings 12:17–18).
description: Hazael of Aram goes up against Jerusalem and Joash buys him off with the temple treasures (2 Kings 12:17–18). Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (section “Hazael”, p. 13).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 855 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, section “Hazael”, p. 13
chronologies.note: Ussher-Jones: Hazael at the apex of his power threatens Jerusalem (2 Kings 12:17–18), two years before Qarqar.
